articles.title: Tesla’s Robotaxi Delays: Who Benefits Most from Waymo’s Lead?
articles.mainIdea: Tesla’s Robotaxi Delays: Who Benefits Most from Waymo’s Lead?
articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Tesla’s Robotaxi Delays: Who Benefits Most from Waymo’s Lead?. Elon Musk admitted something Tesla bulls didn’t want to hear: the Cybercab and Optimus rollout will be “agonizingly slow.” While Tesla stumbles on promises made years ago, Waymo (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is already operating robotaxis in San Francisco, Phoenix, Los Angeles, and Austin. Tesla’s delay isn’t just a missed deadline. It’s a market share transfer to competitors ... Tesla’s Robotaxi Delays: Who Benefits Most from Waymo’s Lead? Related tickers mentioned: GM, GOOG, TSLA, UBER.
